name: Weekly Inverse Volatility Portfolio
description: Volatility-scaled portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Weights are inversely proportional to each asset's 63-day realized volatility, rebalanced weekly. 100% fully invested — lower-vol assets receive higher allocation. Measures risk-adjusted returns and drawdowns via auto-generated tearsheet.
source:
# Weekly Inverse Volatility Portfolio
# SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC — weighted by inverse of 63-day realized vol
# Rebalanced weekly, 100% fully invested, long-only

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Volatility (63-day, annualized) ---
# volatility() takes close prices directly (internally computes returns + annualizes)
vol_63 = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Rebalance Detection ---
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# --- Signal: Always long all 4 assets ---
# Gate entry/exit to weekly rebalance dates
# All assets always held — enter on first rebalance, never exit
always_long = True
held = hold_until()(enter=is_new_week and always_long, exit=False)

# --- Inverse Volatility Weights ---
# inv_vol_weight: weight = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j) for all active assets
# max_weight=0.5 prevents any single asset from dominating
inv_vol_wt = inv_vol_weight(max_weight=0.5)(active_mask=held, volatility=vol_63)

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: all assets always long
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Size as percent of equity, rebalance only on weekly boundary
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=inv_vol_wt.weight * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
